overview: Basic Tool Safety is the field concerned with hand and power tool safety fundamentals for every workshop The Future of Basic Tool Safety belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Secure work — clamps and vises, never hand-holding near blades And Clean shop — tripping and slipping cause as many injuries as tools Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Advanced tier.
core_concepts: Secure work: clamps and vises, never hand-holding near blades
Clean shop: tripping and slipping cause as many injuries as tools
key_laws: Secure the work and keep hands clear of cutting paths.
